problem: Cat moved along unchecked straight segments, ignored its full footprint, and could retain an old bowl obstacle after a drag.
changes: Source-art floor polygon follows the exact aspect-fill transform and excludes furniture, walls, foreground props and offscreen ground.
Cat uniformly resized to min(0.22*sceneWidth,0.27*sceneHeight), about two-thirds of its prior displayed size.
Swept footprint collision checks and obstacle-aware routes cover the entire approach, stroll, pounce and return paths; no unsafe straight fallback.
Regular footprint width/height 1.36/0.25 times cat width; pounce uses 1.60/0.28.
Bowl dragging keeps a reachable eating side and protects the cat; accepted drags always rebuild navigation and cancelled touches restore the draft.
Legacy invalid bowl locations are projected for rendering without rewriting the original save.
Depth sorting uses cat feet and bowl ground anchor, not fixed layer numbers.
